newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER HIT BY PLAYER-COACH ROW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER HIT BY PLAYER-COACH ROW.

text.p: Internazionale go into their UEFA Cup quarter-final against Anderlecht on Tuesday amid growing tension between coach Roy Hodgson and discontented Dutch midfielder Aron Winter.

The official line for Winter's absence from Inter's league defeat by Parma on Saturday was that he was ill. But Hodgson insisted on Sunday that it was a disciplinary measure after Winter criticised the team selection in which he was named as a substitute.

"It obviously wasn't a stomach upset. I tried to keep our difficulties in the family but I have not succeeded," said Hodgson who is leaving at the end of the season to take over at English premier league side Blackburn Rovers.
"I decided to send him to the stands, seeing as he didn't like the bench. I gave him the punishment I thought fitting.
"Now the incident is closed for me. Winter is not out of the squad and on Tuesday he could play," Hodgson said.
